description: RELEASE a sealed file: open <file>.ndc back to its original next to it (never overwrites), and check its hash matches what was sealed. NoData hands the key half back only to the device the seal belongs to, or to another computer of the same person it was sealed for (each opens its own copy with its own key), in the same organisation, after a signed proof, and never after a revoke. A PERSON approves every opening: the call asks NoData, a page opens in the browser, and the file opens only after someone signed in to the organisation clicks Approve (the agent cannot approve; one approval opens once, within 5 minutes). If the call returns WAITING FOR A PERSON, tell the user to approve, then call again. Refuses when this computer is not connected. ASKS FIRST: without confirm:true it only says what would be opened. Writes a local receipt.

confirm.description: true = open it. Omit to preview.
